output.rationale: The requirement specifies metal-clad switchgear with a basic impulse level of 95 kV crest. Among the candidates, the product 'CROWN-ARMV' from the CROWN business unit is described as arc-resistant metal-clad medium-voltage switchgear, which aligns with the specification. This product is offered as engineered-to-order (ETO), suitable for the specific technical requirements of the Syracuse Airport Specification.
